title: Predetermination settlement.
bodyText: At any time after the filing of a complaint, but prior to a determination by the department that this chapter has been violated, the parties may agree to resolve the complaint through a predetermination settlement.
bodyHtml: [§398-22]  Predetermination settlement.  At any time after the filing of a complaint, but prior to a determination by the department that this chapter has been violated, the parties may agree to resolve the complaint through a predetermination settlement. [L 1995, c 154, pt of §3]
